breadcrumb: Std 8 Science (English) — Unit 20: Reaching the Age of Adolescence — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Human developmental stages include infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, middle age and old age. Among all these stages, adolescence is the most crucial and significant period. This period starts at the age of about 13 and ends at the age of 19 (commonly known as teenage).

en.q: Which stage is the most crucial and significant period in an individual's life, the period of transition from childhood to adulthood?
en.explanation: The stages are infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, middle age and old age.

ta.q: குழந்தைப் பருவத்திலிருந்து முதிர்பருவத்திற்கான மாறுதல் காலமான, ஒருவரின் வாழ்வில் மிக முக்கியமான பருவம் எது?
ta.explanation: மனித வளர்ச்சிப் பருவங்கள்: கைக்குழந்தை, குழந்தை, வளரிளம் பருவம், முதிர்பருவம், நடுவயது, முதுமை.

questions.quote: The average age for the onset of puberty is 10-11 for girls and 12-13 for boys. But factors like genetic and biological influences, life events, socio-economic status, nutrition and diet and the amount of body fat also affect the onset and progression of puberty.

en.q: The average age for the onset of puberty is ______ for girls and 12 - 13 for boys.
en.explanation: Nutrition and diet and the amount of body fat also affect the onset of puberty.

ta.q: பூப்பெய்தும் பருவம் தொடங்கும் சராசரி வயது பெண்களுக்கு ______; ஆண்களுக்கு 12 - 13.
ta.explanation: ஊட்டச்சத்து, உணவு, உடல் கொழுப்பின் அளவு ஆகியவையும் பூப்பெய்தும் பருவத் தொடக்கத்தைப் பாதிக்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Growth usually begins at the age of 10 to 12 in girls and 12 to 13 in boys. It is almost complete at around the age of 17 to 19 in girls and 19 to 20 in boys. Both boys and girls add around 23 cm to 26 cm in height. The average weight gain is about 17 kg to 19 kg. Increase in fat is seen in girls in contrast to muscle development in boys.

en.q: During adolescence, an increase in fat is seen in girls in contrast to ______ in boys.
en.explanation: The average weight gain during this period is about 17 to 19 kg.

ta.q: வளரிளம் பருவத்தில் பெண்களில் கொழுப்பு அதிகரிப்பதற்கு மாறாக ஆண்களில் ______ காணப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: இக்காலத்தில் சராசரி எடை அதிகரிப்பு 17 முதல் 19 கிகி.

questions.quote: Secondary sex characters are regulated by testosterone or androgen secreted by the testes and estrogen secreted by the ovaries. Androgens cause the growth of the larynx, muscle development, skeletal size and distribution of body and pubic hair and stimulation of sweat glands. Estrogen and progesterone are the female sex hormones. Estrogen stimulates the development of the breast, external genitalia, pubic and axillary hairs and the distribution of body fat.

en.q: Which hormone stimulates the development of the breast and the distribution of body fat in females?
en.explanation: Androgens cause the growth of the larynx and muscle development.

ta.q: பெண்களில் மார்பக வளர்ச்சியையும் உடல் கொழுப்பின் பரவலையும் தூண்டும் ஹார்மோன் ______.
ta.explanation: ஆண்ட்ரோஜன்கள் குரல்வளை வளர்ச்சியையும் தசை வளர்ச்சியையும் ஏற்படுத்துகின்றன.

questions.quote: Secondary sex characteristics of boys: pubic hair appears followed by axillary and facial hair; skin becomes coarse and the pores enlarge; oil producing glands enlarge causing acne; muscle strength increases; voice becomes husky, its pitch drops and volume increases. At puberty, the growth of the larynx is larger in boys than in girls. In girls the larynx is hardly visible and the voice becomes high pitched.

en.q: In boys, the voice becomes deep and harsh at puberty mainly because of the growth of the ______.
en.explanation: In girls the larynx is hardly visible from outside and the voice becomes high pitched.

ta.q: பூப்பெய்தும் பருவத்தில் ஆண்களின் குரல் ஆழமாகவும் கரகரப்பாகவும் மாறுவதற்கு முக்கியக் காரணம் ______ வளர்ச்சி.
ta.explanation: பெண்களில் குரல்வளை வெளியே தெரியாது; குரல் கீச்சுக் குரலாகும்.

questions.quote: Girls' secondary sex characteristics: due to enlargement of the pelvic bone and the development of subcutaneous fat, the hip becomes wider and rounder; after the enlargement of the hip the breasts begin to develop; pubic hair appears followed by axillary and body hair; voice becomes shrill and voice breaks are rare among girls.

en.q: Voice breaks are rare among ______, whose voice becomes shrill.
en.explanation: In boys, voice break takes place due to lengthening of vocal chords and enlarging of the larynx.

ta.q: குரல் உடைதல் ______ இல் அரிது; அவர்களின் குரல் கீச்சுக் குரலாகிறது.
ta.explanation: ஆண்களில் குரல் நாண்கள் நீள்வதாலும் குரல்வளை பெரிதாவதாலும் குரல் உடைகிறது.

questions.quote: Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH): in the female it influences the development of the Graafian follicle and secretion of estrogens; in the male it is necessary for the development of seminiferous tubules and for spermatogenesis. Luteinizing Hormone (LH): in the female necessary for ovulation and the secretion of progesterone. Prolactin (PRL): milk secretion during lactation. Oxytocin: expulsion of milk and contraction of smooth muscles of uterus during child birth.

en.q: Which hormone causes the expulsion of milk from the breast and the contraction of uterine muscles during child birth?
en.explanation: Prolactin controls milk secretion during lactation.

ta.q: மார்பகத்திலிருந்து பாலை வெளியேற்றி, பிரசவத்தின்போது கருப்பைத் தசைகளைச் சுருக்கும் ஹார்மோன் ______.
ta.explanation: புரோலாக்டின் பாலூட்டும் காலத்தில் பால் சுரப்பைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துகிறது.

questions.quote: In females, the reproductive phase of life begins at puberty (10 to 12 years of age) and generally lasts till the age of approximately 45 to 50 years, and in males, it is from the age of 13 to life long. Ovulation occurs approximately 14 days before the next ovarian cycle commences. One ovum matures and is released by one of the ovaries once in about 28 to 30 days.

en.q: In females, the reproductive phase generally lasts till the age of approximately ______ years.
en.explanation: In males it is from the age of 13 to life long.

ta.q: பெண்களில் இனப்பெருக்கப் பருவம் பொதுவாக ஏறத்தாழ ______ வயது வரை நீடிக்கும்.
ta.explanation: ஆண்களில் 13 வயது முதல் வாழ்நாள் முழுவதும் நீடிக்கும்.

questions.quote: Menstruation occurs once in about 28 to 30 days. It takes about 3 to 5 days. Menopause marks the end of the reproductive phase of a woman's life. At 45 to 50 years of age, the menstrual cycle stops. If menstrual cycle remains irregular for over a year, then it is better to consult a doctor.

en.q: The stoppage of menstruation at 45 to 50 years of age is termed ______.
en.explanation: Menopause marks the end of the reproductive phase of a woman's life.

ta.explanation: இது பெண்ணின் இனப்பெருக்கப் பருவத்தின் முடிவைக் குறிக்கிறது.

questions.quote: Menstrual cycle: The menstrual cycle begins with the casting off of endometrial lining of the uterus and bleeding. Menstruation occurs if an ovum released by the ovary is not fertilized during ovulation. Menstruation stops temporarily when the ovum gets fertilized and the woman gets pregnant. Menstruation also stops due to nutritional deficiencies, low body weight, stress, eating disorder, excessive weight gain etc.

en.q: Menstruation occurs if the ovum released by the ovary is ______.

questions.quote: The World Health Organisation (WHO) has defined reproductive health as the total well-being of behavioural, emotional, physical and social aspects of adolescence. During this period about 8 to 10 hours of sleep each night is necessary.

en.q: During adolescence, about ______ of sleep each night is necessary.
en.explanation: Sleep is vital to the well-being of adolescents.

ta.q: வளரிளம் பருவத்தில் இரவில் ஏறத்தாழ ______ உறக்கம் தேவை.

questions.quote: Cleanliness: have a bath once or twice a day, paying special attention to underarms, groins and genitals. Change the underwear daily; it should be made of cotton. Physical exercise: walking and playing in fresh air keeps the body fit and healthy.

en.q: Underwear for teenagers should be made of ______ and changed daily.
en.explanation: Teenagers should bathe once or twice a day.

ta.q: வளரிளம் பருவத்தினரின் உள்ளாடைகள் ______ ஆல் செய்யப்பட்டவையாகவும் தினமும் மாற்றப்பட வேண்டியவையாகவும் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
ta.explanation: வளரிளம் பருவத்தினர் நாளுக்கு ஒன்று அல்லது இரு முறை குளிக்க வேண்டும்.

questions.quote: Calcium: intake needs to be increased to prevent osteoporosis in later life. It is present in milk and milk products. Iron builds blood; iron-rich foods such as green leafy vegetables, jaggery, meat, dates, fish, chicken, citrus, Indian gooseberry (Nelli) and whole pulses are good for adolescents. Iodine helps to prevent thyroid gland related diseases.

en.q: Which of the following is an iron-rich food good for adolescents?
en.explanation: Iron builds blood; iron deficiency results in anaemia.

ta.q: வளரிளம் பருவத்தினருக்கு நல்லதான இரும்புச் சத்து மிகுந்த உணவு எது?
ta.explanation: இரும்பு இரத்தத்தை உருவாக்கும்; இரும்புக் குறைபாடு இரத்தசோகையை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

questions.quote: Personal hygiene habits for adolescence: shower or bath daily; always wash your hands before and after meals; keep finger nails clean and avoid nail polish; wash your teeth and mouth before and after each meal; avoid coughing or sneezing around food; change your clothes regularly; do not defecate in open field; if you are not well, avoid self-medication and consult a doctor.

en.q: Which of the following is a good personal hygiene habit?
options: Washing hands before and after meals
Using the same undergarments for many days
en.explanation: One should consult a doctor if not well.

ta.q: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் நல்ல தனிநபர் சுகாதாரப் பழக்கம் எது?

questions.quote: Testosterone is the male hormone and estrogen is the female hormone that bring about development of several secondary sex characters. Hormones are the secretions of endocrine glands without ducts which secrete them directly into the bloodstream. The uterine wall in female prepares itself to receive the developing fertilized eggs.

en.q: Hormones are secretions of ______ glands which secrete them directly into the bloodstream.
en.explanation: Testosterone and estrogen bring about the development of secondary sex characters.

ta.q: ஹார்மோன்கள் என்பவை நேரடியாக இரத்தத்தில் சுரக்கும் ______ சுரப்பிகளின் சுரப்புகள்.
ta.explanation: டெஸ்டோஸ்டிரோன், ஈஸ்ட்ரோஜன் இரண்டாம் நிலைப் பாலினப் பண்புகளை வளர்க்கின்றன.
